questions.question: When braking, you should use:

options.text: Only the front brake.
Only the rear brake.
Both brakes.
Either brake, but never both at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both brakes at the same time when stopping. Both brakes work best together.

questions.question: Which type of sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?

options.text: Warning
Service
Regulatory
Speed limit

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: The shortest and safest stops are accomplished:

options.text: By using only the rear brake.
By using only the front brake.
By allowing the front tire to lock up.
By using both the front and rear brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: By using both the front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both the front and rear brakes smoothly to stop safely and quickly. Do not lock up either tire.

questions.question: In general, the body gets rid of almost ______ per hour.

options.text: One drink
Two drinks
Three drinks
Four drinks

questions.correctAnswerText: One drink
questions.explanation: Your body eliminates about one drink of alcohol per hour.

questions.question: During the day, you should:

options.text: Not ride with your headlight on.
Ride with your headlight on only when it is cloudy.
Always ride with your headlight on.
Use your headlight only if you think it helps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always ride with your headlight on.
questions.explanation: Always keep your headlight on when riding, even during the day. This makes other drivers twice as likely to see you.

questions.question: Which of the following surfaces provides the best traction for a motorcycle?

options.text: A gravel road
Dry pavement
Mud
Lane markings

questions.correctAnswerText: Dry pavement
questions.explanation: Dry pavement provides the best traction. Wet pavement, gravel, mud, snow, ice, lane markings, and metal road covers are all hazardous for motorcycles.

questions.question: Which of the following is not protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?

options.text: Jacket
Boots
Gloves
Sandals

questions.correctAnswerText: Sandals
questions.explanation: Riders should wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves. Sandals do not protect you.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, motorcycle riders should be especially cautious of:

options.text: Motorists looking for a place to park.
Cars leaving their parking spaces.
Oncoming traffic.
Noise.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars leaving their parking spaces.
questions.explanation: Watch for vehicles that may pull away from the curb or leave parking spaces while you are passing.

questions.question: Studies show that when motorcycles have their headlights turned on during the day:

options.text: They are not as easy to see as other vehicles.
They are more visible to other drivers than when their headlights are turned off.
Other drivers are often confused.
They are less safe than when their headlights are turned off.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are more visible to other drivers than when their headlights are turned off.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle with its headlight on is twice as likely to be noticed by other drivers during the day.

questions.question: A simple way to make your motorcycle easier to see is to:

options.text: Ride with a large flag attached to its frame.
Ride with the headlight turned on.
Wave at other drivers.
Ride on the shoulder whenever possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride with the headlight turned on.
questions.explanation: Keep your headlight on at all times. Wear bright, reflective clothing. Use your turn signals and brake light properly.

questions.question: Where should you find the best information about your motorcycle?

options.text: The owner's manual
A general book about motorcycles
Someone who owns a different type of motorcycle
A television show about motorcycle riding

questions.correctAnswerText: The owner's manual
questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle. It tells you about your specific motorcycle.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the most protection to motorcycle riders?

options.text: Leather
Denim
Polyester
Wool

questions.correctAnswerText: Leather
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the best protection when riding a motorcycle.

questions.question: How does a motorcycle's brake light compare to a car's brake lights?

options.text: It is more noticeable
It is less noticeable
It is less important
It is easier to see

questions.correctAnswerText: It is less noticeable
questions.explanation: A motorcycle's brake light is usually not as noticeable as a car's brake lights. Flash your brake light before slowing or stopping to help other drivers see that you are braking.

questions.question: When should you leave extra space between your motorcycle and the vehicle ahead?

options.text: When stopping will be harder than usual
When you want to look at the scenery
To encourage other drivers to cut you off
To prevent the driver ahead from knowing you are there

questions.correctAnswerText: When stopping will be harder than usual
questions.explanation: Leave more space between your motorcycle and the vehicle ahead when your motorcycle will take longer to stop. This includes wet roads, when you cannot see ahead clearly, or when traffic is heavy and another driver might cut in front of you.

questions.question: What is the main psychoactive substance in marijuana?

options.text: THC
TMJ
MRT
AAP

questions.correctAnswerText: THC
questions.explanation: THC stands for tetrahydrocannabinol. It is the main substance in marijuana that affects the mind.

questions.question: What is true about an approved helmet?

options.text: It allows you to see to the sides as far as needed
It blocks your side vision
It is usually uncomfortable
It has no labels or markings

questions.correctAnswerText: It allows you to see to the sides as far as needed
questions.explanation: An approved helmet lets you see to the sides as far as needed for safe riding. Approved helmets have labels and markings showing the manufacturer's name, instructions, and the safety standards they meet.

questions.question: What should you do with your feet when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Drag them on the ground
Point your toes downward
Keep them firmly on the footrests
Keep them away from the controls

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep them firmly on the footrests
questions.explanation: Keep your feet firmly on the footrests to stay balanced. Do not drag your feet or point them downward, as they may catch on the road. Keep your feet near the controls so you can use them quickly if needed.

questions.question: How should you use mirror checks when riding?

options.text: Make them part of your regular scanning routine
Avoid them because they will distract you
Avoid them because other drivers can see you easily
Use them only in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: Make them part of your regular scanning routine
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to know what is behind you. Frequent mirror checks should be part of your normal search routine for safety.

questions.question: What should you do when riding with a passenger?

options.text: Assume they have ridden a motorcycle before
Do not assume they have ridden before and explain what they need to do
Do not let them ask questions
Do not explain anything since they are just a passenger

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not assume they have ridden before and explain what they need to do
questions.explanation: Never assume your passenger knows how to ride safely on a motorcycle. Give them complete instructions before every ride so both of you stay safe.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes?

options.text: You do not need to look over your shoulder if you use your mirrors
Mirrors give you a full view of the road around your motorcycle
Turn your head and look over your shoulder
You can assume drivers will respond correctly to your turn signal

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like any vehicle. Always turn your head and look over your shoulder to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a good choice for riding clothes?

options.text: A jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely
Boots or shoes that cover your ankles
Gloves made of leather
A baseball cap to cover your hair

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap to cover your hair
questions.explanation: To stay safe, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: How long does a pre-ride inspection take?

options.text: A few minutes and should be done no more than once a month.
A few minutes and should be done before every ride.
Over an hour and should be performed by a mechanic.
Over an hour and must only be done if you will be carrying a passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: A few minutes and should be done before every ride.
questions.explanation: Do a pre-ride inspection before every ride. It should take only a few minutes.

questions.question: What can you do in a no passing zone?

options.text: A motorcycle may still pass another vehicle.
A motorcycle is not allowed to pass another vehicle.
A motorcycle may pass another vehicle if the pass can be completed before another vehicle approaches.
A motorcycle may pass on the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: A motorcycle is not allowed to pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Do not pass in no passing zones. Do not pass by riding off the road either.

questions.question: What should you do with shoelaces while riding?

options.text: Should be tucked in.
Should hang loose.
Should be taken off of the footwear.
Should be glued together.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be tucked in.
questions.explanation: Tuck in shoelaces securely so they do not catch on your motorcycle.

questions.question: Which sign is rectangular in shape?

options.text: School crossing sign.
Railroad crossing sign.
Stop sign.
Speed limit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed limit sign.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs and other regulatory signs are rectangular with white background and black lettering. You must follow the rules on these signs.
